summary: This Makefile snippet sets up a build target that converts a file from Markdown to PDF format. It defines a color constant for terminal output, creates a variable for the output filename by replacing the .md extension with .pdf, and then prints a colored message to the user showing what file will be converted and where it will go.

explanations.1: The colon-equals operator creates a variable called 'outfile' that takes the INFILE variable and swaps .md with .pdf at the end—so if INFILE is 'readme.md', outfile becomes 'readme.pdf'.
explanations.3: This defines a constant variable COLOR_BLUE with the value 34, which is the ANSI terminal color code for blue.
explanations.6: The printf command with \e escape sequences prints colored text to the terminal—the \e[1;34m part turns text blue and bold, and \e[0m resets it back to normal. The %s gets replaced with the message about the input and output files.
